subject.title: fix(reef): restore inbox recovery after gateway restart

question: Can a Reef owner provide or approve redacted after-fix gateway-restart evidence showing the persisted cursor is used and the channel reaches connected status on this exact head?
rationale: The public branch evidence is limited to tests and a pre-fix diagnosis; the omitted authenticated-host diagnostics are the only stated source for the real behavior claim, and the protected label requires an explicit human proof decision.

options.title: Add redacted restart diagnostics
options.body: Post terminal output or logs from the exact head that show a restart, nonzero cursor catch-up, successful live connection, and final connected channel status.

options.title: Approve private proof
options.body: A Reef owner may review the private operational diagnostics and explicitly record that they demonstrate the exact-head recovery behavior.

recommendation.title: Add redacted restart diagnostics
recommendation.body: Post terminal output or logs from the exact head that show a restart, nonzero cursor catch-up, successful live connection, and final connected channel status.

likelyOwner.reason: They supplied the production diagnosis and authored the recovery implementation, so they are best placed to provide or route the redacted proof.
